name: A Night With Angel
source:
Angel is an alluring and confident twink with a charisma that can make anyone's heart flutter- he isn't just anyone; he's a dream wrapped in a riddle. Each word, each glance, has deeper meanings as the two of you spend a fleeting night's tryst with eachother.

Will you be able to unravel the mystery that is Angel the nightwalking wet dream?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2509190/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
安吉尔是一个迷人而自信的小伙子，他的魅力可以让任何人心动——他不仅仅是任何人；他是一个充满魅力的男孩。他是一个被谜语包裹着的梦。两人的一夜幽会，每一个字，每一个眼神，都有更深的含义。

你能解开夜行遗梦天使的谜团吗？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2509190/]Steam[/url]]
